exercises.instructionEn: Read the following dialogue and fill in the gaps with the sentences below.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi dialogni o'qing va bo'shliqlarni quyidagi gaplar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh GAP BERILGAN:
  • Okay, I'll meet you at seven thirty then.
  • I haven't got any plans. Why?
  • That's a good idea. What time does it
    start?


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  I haven't got any plans. Why?
  2  That's a good idea. What time does it
     start?
  3  Okay, I'll meet you at seven thirty then.


TO'LIQ DIALOG:

  A: Hello, Sally. What are you doing tomorrow
     night?
  B: I HAVEN'T GOT ANY PLANS. WHY?
  A: I've got two tickets for the Jupiter Rock
     Festival. Would you like to go with me?
  B: THAT'S A GOOD IDEA. WHAT TIME DOES IT
     START?
  A: It starts at eight o'clock.
  B: OKAY, I'LL MEET YOU AT SEVEN THIRTY THEN.


Tarjimasi:
  A: Salom, Salli. Ertaga kechqurun nima
     qilyapsan?
  B: Hech qanday rejam yo'q. Nima edi?
  A: Menda Jupiter rok festivaliga ikkita
     chipta bor. Men bilan borishni
     xohlaysanmi?
  B: Yaxshi fikr. Soat nechada boshlanadi?
  A: Soat sakkizda boshlanadi.
  B: Yaxshi, unda seni yetti yarimda kutaman.


⚠ QANDAY ANIQLANADI — HAR JAVOB OLDINGI VA
KEYINGI GAPGA BOG'LANADI:

 1  Savol: 'What are you doing tomorrow
    night?' (reja haqida)
    Javob: 'I haven't got any PLANS. Why?'
    ('plans' so'zi savolga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri
     javob)

 2  Savol: 'Would you like to go with me?'
    Javob: 'That's a GOOD IDEA.' (rozilik)
    + yangi savol: 'What time does it START?'

    Va A javob beradi: 'It STARTS at eight
    o'clock.' — demak 2-bandda 'start' haqida
    savol bo'lishi kerak!

 3  A: 'It starts at EIGHT o'clock.'
    B: 'Okay, I'll meet you at SEVEN THIRTY
       then.'

    MANTIQ: agar sakkizda boshlansa, yetti
    yarimda uchrashish kerak (yarim soat
    oldin).


⚠ ENG ISHONChLI BELGI — 2-BAND:
  Keyingi gap 'It STARTS at eight o'clock'
  javob berayapti.

  Demak 2-bandda 'What time does it START?'
  savoli bo'lishi SHART.


DIALOGDAGI ZAMONLAR:

  'What ARE YOU DOING tomorrow night?'
     → PRESENT CONTINUOUS (kelajak reja)
  'I HAVEN'T GOT any plans.'
     → 'have got' = bor/yo'q (britancha)
  'I'VE GOT two tickets.'
     → 'have got'
  'WOULD YOU LIKE to go ...?'
     → odobli taklif
  'What time DOES IT START?'
     → PRESENT SIMPLE (jadval bo'yicha)
  'It STARTS at eight.'
     → PRESENT SIMPLE
  'I'LL MEET you at seven thirty.'
     → WILL (ayni damdagi qaror)


⚠ DIQQAT — 'STARTS' NEGA PRESENT SIMPLE:
  Festival, kino, poyezd kabi JADVAL bo'yicha
  bo'ladigan narsalar PRESENT SIMPLE da
  aytiladi, garchi KELAJAK haqida bo'lsa ham:

     'The film STARTS at eight.'
     'The train LEAVES at six.'
     'The concert BEGINS at nine.'

  Bu — maxsus qoida.


DIQQAT — 'I'LL MEET YOU':
  'I'LL meet you at seven thirty.'
  Qaror AYNI DAMDA qabul qilinyapti
  (vaqtni eshitgandan keyin) → WILL.

  Coursebook 108-bet, 1-dialog:
  'Okay. I'LL PICK YOU UP at eight, then.'
  — juda o'xshash.


DIQQAT — 'THEN':
  'Okay, I'll meet you at seven thirty THEN.'
  'then' bu yerda = 'unda' (xulosa).
  Gap oxirida turadi.


DIQQAT — VAQTNI AYTISh:
  'seven thirty' = 7:30 (yetti yarim)
  'half past seven' — ham to'g'ri (britancha)
  'eight o'clock' = 8:00 (rosa sakkiz)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  plans      = rejalar
  a ticket   = chipta
  a rock festival = rok festivali
  to start   = boshlanmoq
  to meet    = uchrashmoq
  seven thirty = yetti yarim (7:30)
  then       = unda; o'shanda

pairs.left: 1  A: Hello, Sally. What are you doing tomorrow night?
pairs.right: I haven't got any plans. Why?

KALIT: savol REJA haqida ('What are you
doing tomorrow night?').

Javobda 'PLANS' so'zi bor — to'g'ridan-to'g'ri
javob.

'Why?' — suhbatni davom ettiradi (A ning
nimadir taklif qilishini kutadi).

'have got' = bor/yo'q (britancha shakl).

pairs.left: 2  A: I've got two tickets for the Jupiter Rock Festival. Would you like to go with me?
pairs.right: That's a good idea. What time does it start?

⚠ ENG ISHONCHLI BELGI:
Keyingi gap 'It STARTS at eight o'clock'
JAVOB berayapti.

Demak bu bandda 'What time does it START?'
savoli bo'lishi SHART.

Yana: 'That's a good idea' — taklifga
ROZILIK.

'does it START' — PRESENT SIMPLE, chunki
jadval bo'yicha.

pairs.left: 3  A: It starts at eight o'clock.
pairs.right: Okay, I'll meet you at seven thirty then.
pairs.rightUz: Yaxshi, unda seni yetti yarimda kutaman.

MANTIQ: agar SAKKIZDA boshlansa, YETTI
YARIMDA uchrashish kerak (yarim soat oldin).

'I'LL meet you' — qaror AYNI DAMDA qabul
qilinyapti (vaqtni eshitgandan keyin) → WILL.

Coursebook 108-bet, 1-dialog bilan juda
o'xshash: 'Okay. I'LL PICK YOU UP at eight,
then.'

'then' = unda (gap oxirida).

exercises.instructionEn: Read the letter below and put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi xatni o'qing va qavs ichidagi fe'llarni to'g'ri zamonga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  IS
   2  AM HAVING
   3  ARE STAYING
   4  HAVE BEEN
   5  HAVE ALREADY DONE
   6  HAVE TAKEN
   7  DID
   8  WAS
   9  HAVE ALSO VISITED
  10  VISITED
  11  WERE
  12  BOUGHT
  13  HAVEN'T DONE
  14  HAVEN'T VISITED
  15  HAVEN'T BEEN
  16  ARE VISITING
  17  ARE ALSO GOING TO VISIT
  18  IS
  19  IS
  20  ARE RETURNING
  21  WILL SEE / 'LL SEE


TO'LIQ XAT (javoblar bilan):

  Dear Ellen,

  Hello from Amsterdam! The weather IS sunny
  and I AM HAVING a fantastic time. David and
  I ARE STAYING at a lovely hotel in the city
  centre. We HAVE BEEN here since Tuesday and
  we HAVE ALREADY DONE many interesting
  things.

  We HAVE TAKEN a boat trip down the Amstel
  River. We DID that on Wednesday. It WAS
  amazing! We HAVE ALSO VISITED the Van Gogh
  Museum. We VISITED it on Thursday. The
  paintings WERE fascinating. I BOUGHT some
  great posters there.

  There are a lot of things we HAVEN'T DONE
  yet. We HAVEN'T VISITED the Anne Frank House
  and we HAVEN'T BEEN to the Artis Zoo. We ARE
  VISITING the zoo tomorrow to see the
  animals. We ARE ALSO GOING TO VISIT the
  Stedelijk Museum. It IS famous for its large
  collection of modern art.

  Amsterdam IS a magnificent city — you must
  see it one day. We ARE RETURNING to New York
  on the 15th, so I WILL SEE you then.

                            Lots of love,
                            Janet


⚠ BU XAT — UNIT 15 NING UChINChI NUSXASI:

  Jek (Qohira, CB 105) →
  Laura (Dublin, GB 67) →
  Janet (Amsterdam, WB 63)

  Uchalasi ham AYNAN bir xil tuzilishda!


ZAMONLAR BO'YIChA GURUHLAR:

  PRESENT SIMPLE — 1, 18, 19
     (doimiy holat, fikr)
  PRESENT CONTINUOUS — 2, 3, 16, 20
     (vaqtinchalik holat; kelajak reja)
  PRESENT PERFECT — 4, 5, 6, 9, 13, 14, 15
     (vaqt aytilmagan; 'since', 'already',
      'yet')
  PAST SIMPLE — 7, 8, 10, 11, 12
     (aniq vaqt: 'on Wednesday',
      'on Thursday'; baho)
  BE GOING TO — 17
     (aniq vaqtsiz reja)
  WILL — 21
     (va'da)


⚠ ENG MUHIM NAQSh — 6/7 va 9/10:

   6  'We HAVE TAKEN a boat trip.'   (xabar)
   7  'We DID that ON WEDNESDAY.'    (aniq
                                      vaqt)

   9  'We HAVE ALSO VISITED the Van Gogh
       Museum.'                       (xabar)
  10  'We VISITED it ON THURSDAY.'    (aniq
                                      vaqt)

  Present Perfect → Past Simple.


⚠ 16 va 17-BANDLAR FARQI:

  16  'We ARE VISITING the zoo TOMORROW.'
      'tomorrow' — ANIQ vaqt →
      PRESENT CONTINUOUS
      ('are going to visit' ham to'g'ri)

  17  'We ARE ALSO GOING TO VISIT the
       Stedelijk Museum.'
      Vaqt AYTILMAGAN → BE GOING TO

  Jekning xati ham xuddi shunday edi:
     'We ARE GOING on a boat trip TOMORROW'
     'we ARE GOING TO VISIT the museum ONE OF
      THESE DAYS'


HAR BIRI QISQAChA:

 1  'The weather ... sunny' — hozirgi holat
    → IS
 2  'I ... a fantastic time' — hozir
    → AM HAVING
 3  'David and I ... at a hotel' —
    VAQTINChALIK → ARE STAYING
    (ega 'David and I' — KO'PLIK → ARE!)
 4  'We ... here SINCE Tuesday' → HAVE BEEN
 5  'we ... (already/do)' → HAVE ALREADY DONE
 6  'We ... a boat trip' (vaqt yo'q)
    → HAVE TAKEN
 7  'We ... that ON WEDNESDAY' → DID
 8  'It ... amazing!' — baho → WAS
 9  'We ... (also/visit)' (vaqt yo'q)
    → HAVE ALSO VISITED
10  'We ... it ON THURSDAY' → VISITED
11  'The paintings ... fascinating' — baho,
    KO'PLIK ega → WERE
12  'I ... some posters' — o'sha tashrifda
    → BOUGHT
13  'things we ... YET' → HAVEN'T DONE
14  'We ... the Anne Frank House' (yet)
    → HAVEN'T VISITED
15  'we ... to the Artis Zoo' (yet)
    → HAVEN'T BEEN
    (DIQQAT: 'gone' EMAS!)
16  'We ... the zoo TOMORROW' → ARE VISITING
17  'We ... (also/visit) the Stedelijk Museum'
    → ARE ALSO GOING TO VISIT
18  'It ... famous for ...' → IS
19  'Amsterdam ... a magnificent city' → IS
20  'We ... to New York ON THE 15TH'
    → ARE RETURNING
21  'so I ... you then' — va'da → WILL SEE


⚠ 11-BAND — KO'PLIK EGA:
  'The PAINTINGS ... fascinating.'
  'paintings' — KO'PLIK → WERE ('was' emas).


⚠ 3-BAND — KO'PLIK EGA:
  'DAVID AND I ... at a lovely hotel.'
  'David and I' = WE → ARE ('am' emas).


AMSTERDAMDAGI JOYLAR:
  the Amstel River — shahar nomi kelib chiqqan
     daryo
  the Van Gogh Museum — Van Gog muzeyi
  the Anne Frank House — Anna Frank uyi
  the Artis Zoo — Yevropadagi eng qadimiy
     hayvonot bog'laridan biri
  the Stedelijk Museum — zamonaviy san'at
     muzeyi


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Amsterdam  = Amsterdam (Niderlandiya)
  a painting = kartina
  fascinating = maftunkor
  a poster   = plakat
  a collection = to'plam
  modern art = zamonaviy san'at
  magnificent = ulug'vor
  Lots of love = Katta mehr bilan

commonMistake.whyUz:
Hozirgi holat → PRESENT SIMPLE.

Jek va Lauraning xatlari ham shunday
boshlangan: 'The weather IS ...'

Hozir davom etayotgan → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

'to have a fantastic time' — bu ma'noda
'have' Continuous BO'LADI.

items.sentence: 3  David and I ....................... (stay) at a lovely hotel in the city centre.
items.uz: Devid bilan ikkalamiz shahar markazidagi go'zal mehmonxonada turibmiz.

commonMistake.whyUz:
VAQTINCHALIK turish → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

⚠ EGA: 'DAVID AND I' — KO'PLIK (= WE)
→ 'ARE staying' ('am' EMAS!)

Bu — eng ko'p unutiladigan joy.

KALIT: 'SINCE Tuesday' → PRESENT PERFECT.
be → BEEN.

items.uz: va allaqachon ko'p qiziqarli ishlar qildik.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'ALREADY' → PRESENT PERFECT.
'already' — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA.
do → DONE.

items.sentence: 6  We ....................... (take) a boat trip down the Amstel River.
items.uz: Amstel daryosi bo'ylab qayiqda sayohat qildik.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Vaqt AYTILMAGAN → PRESENT PERFECT.
take → TAKEN (V3).

⚠ 7-BAND BILAN JUFT: xabar → aniq vaqt.

KALIT: 'ON WEDNESDAY' — ANIQ VAQT
→ PAST SIMPLE.
do → DID (V2).

Unit 15 ning oltin qoidasi.

O'sha sayohat haqida BAHO → PAST SIMPLE.

Baho DOIM Past Simple da beriladi.

Vaqt AYTILMAGAN → PRESENT PERFECT.
'ALSO' — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA.

⚠ 10-BAND BILAN JUFT.

KALIT: 'ON THURSDAY' — ANIQ VAQT
→ PAST SIMPLE.

visit → VISITED (to'g'ri fe'l).

BAHO → PAST SIMPLE.

⚠ EGA: 'The PAINTINGS' — KO'PLIK
→ WERE ('was' EMAS!)

'a painting' = kartina.

items.uz: U yerdan zo'r plakatlar sotib oldim.

commonMistake.whyUz:
O'sha tashrifda (payshanba) → PAST SIMPLE.

buy → BOUGHT (V2 = V3).

Jekning xati: 'I BOUGHT some lovely handmade
souvenirs there.'

items.sentence: 13  There are a lot of things we ....................... (not/do) yet.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'YET' → PRESENT PERFECT INKOR.

Jek va Lauraning xatlarida ham AYNAN shu gap
bor edi.

'YET' ma'nosi davom etadi → PRESENT PERFECT
INKOR.

visit → VISITED (V3).

items.sentence: 15  and we ....................... (not/go) to the Artis Zoo.

commonMistake.whyUz:
PRESENT PERFECT INKOR.

⚠ 'BEEN', 'GONE' EMAS!
Workbook 60-bet, 6-mashq qoidasi:
'have BEEN to' = tajriba (borib qaytish).

Agar 'gone' bo'lsa, hozir hayvonot bog'ida
bo'lardilar — lekin xat yozyaptilar.

items.sentence: 16  We ....................... (visit) the zoo tomorrow to see the animals.
items.uz: Ertaga hayvonlarni ko'rish uchun hayvonot bog'iga boramiz.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'TOMORROW' — ANIQ vaqtli reja
→ PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

('are going to visit' ham to'g'ri —
ikkalasi qabul qilinadi.)

'TO see' — maqsad.

Vaqt AYTILMAGAN reja → BE GOING TO.

⚠ 16-BAND BILAN FARQI:
  16  'TOMORROW' bor → Present Continuous
  17  vaqt YO'Q → be going to

Jekning xati ham shunday:
'We are going on a boat trip TOMORROW and we
are GOING TO VISIT the museum one of these
days.'

items.sentence: 18  It ....................... (be) famous for its large collection of modern art.
items.uz: U zamonaviy san'atning katta to'plami bilan mashhur.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Doimiy haqiqat → PRESENT SIMPLE.

'famous FOR' — predlog 'for'
(Coursebook 105-bet, 7-mashq).

Doimiy holat / fikr → PRESENT SIMPLE.

Jekning xati: 'Cairo IS a fascinating city.'
Lauraning xati: 'Dublin IS a very friendly
city.'

items.sentence: 20  We ....................... (return) to New York on the 15th,

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'ON THE 15TH' — ANIQ SANALI REJA
→ PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

Jekning xati: 'I'M RETURNING to England ON
SUNDAY next week.'

VA'DA → WILL.

Jekning xati: 'so I'LL CALL you then.'
Lauraning xati: 'so I WILL CALL you then.'

Uchala xat ham shu gap bilan tugaydi!

exercises.instructionEn: Then, correct the statements, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT GAP — HAMMASI NOTO'G'RI, TUZATISh
KERAK.

QOLIP (kitobdagi namunadan):
  1) INKOR gap: 'They HAVEN'T ... '
  2) TO'G'RI ma'lumot: 'They HAVE ... '


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  'They have been there since Monday.'
    → 'They HAVEN'T been there since MONDAY.
       They HAVE been there since TUESDAY.'
    (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

    Xatdan: 'We have been here SINCE TUESDAY.'

 2  'They visited the Van Gogh Museum on
     Wednesday.'
    → 'They DIDN'T VISIT the Van Gogh Museum
       on WEDNESDAY. They VISITED it on
       THURSDAY.'

    Xatdan: 'We visited it ON THURSDAY.'
    (Chorshanba kuni QAYIQDA sayohat
     qilishgan!)

 3  'They are going to visit the Anne Frank
     House tomorrow.'
    → 'They AREN'T GOING TO VISIT the Anne
       Frank House tomorrow. They ARE VISITING
       the ARTIS ZOO tomorrow.'

    Xatdan: 'We are visiting THE ZOO
    TOMORROW.'
    (Anna Frank uyiga HALI BORMAGANLAR.)

 4  'They are returning to New York on the
     25th.'
    → 'They AREN'T RETURNING to New York on
       the 25TH. They ARE RETURNING on the
       15TH.'

    Xatdan: 'We are returning to New York ON
    THE 15TH.'


⚠ TUZATISh QOLIPI — IKKI GAP:

  1-gap: INKOR (noto'g'ri ma'lumotni rad
         etish)
  2-gap: TASDIQ (to'g'ri ma'lumot)

  Namunada aynan shunday:
     'They HAVEN'T been there since Monday.
      They HAVE been there since Tuesday.'


⚠ INKOR ShAKLI ZAMONGA QARAB O'ZGARADI:

  1  Present Perfect → HAVEN'T been
  2  Past Simple     → DIDN'T visit
  3  be going to     → AREN'T going to visit
  4  Present Continuous → AREN'T returning

  Ya'ni har gapning O'Z zamoni saqlanadi.


⚠ 2-BAND — ENG NOZIK:
  'DIDN'T VISIT' — 'didn't' dan keyin ASOSIY
  shakl!
     'They didn't VISIT'   ✓
     'They didn't VISITED' ✗


⚠ 3-BAND — NIMA ALMAShADI:
  Noto'g'ri: 'the Anne Frank House tomorrow'
  To'g'ri:   'the Artis Zoo tomorrow'

  Xatda Anna Frank uyi HALI BORILMAGAN
  ishlar ro'yxatida, hayvonot bog'i esa
  ERTANGI reja.


DIQQAT — OLMOShLAR:
  Xatda 'WE' (Janet va Devid),
  gaplarda 'THEY' (uchinchi shaxs).

  Chunki gaplar xat haqida GAPIRYAPTI.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a statement = gap, bayonot
  to correct  = tuzatmoq

points.en: 1  They have been there since Monday.  →  They haven't been there since Monday. They have been there since Tuesday.
points.uz: Ular u yerda dushanbadan beri emas. Ular seshanbadan beri u yerda.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.

QOLIP: INKOR gap + TO'G'RI ma'lumot.
Xatdan: 'We have been here SINCE TUESDAY.'

points.en: 2  They visited the Van Gogh Museum on Wednesday.  →  They didn't visit the Van Gogh Museum on Wednesday. They visited it on Thursday.
points.uz: Ular Van Gog muzeyiga chorshanba kuni bormadi. Ular u yerga payshanba kuni borishdi.
points.noteUz:
Xatdan: 'We visited it ON THURSDAY.'
(Chorshanba kuni QAYIQDA sayohat qilishgan.)

⚠ 'DIDN'T' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
'didn't VISIT' ✓ / 'didn't VISITED' ✗

points.en: 3  They are going to visit the Anne Frank House tomorrow.  →  They aren't going to visit the Anne Frank House tomorrow. They are visiting the Artis Zoo tomorrow.
points.uz: Ular ertaga Anna Frank uyiga bormaydi. Ular ertaga Artis hayvonot bog'iga borishadi.
points.noteUz:
Xatda Anna Frank uyi — HALI BORILMAGAN
ishlar ro'yxatida;
hayvonot bog'i — ERTANGI reja.

Inkor: 'AREN'T going to visit'.

points.en: 4  They are returning to New York on the 25th.  →  They aren't returning to New York on the 25th. They are returning on the 15th.
points.noteUz:
Xatdan: 'We are returning to New York ON THE
15TH.'

Inkor: 'AREN'T returning' (Present
Continuous).

sections.title: Writing — a letter about your holiday in Rhodes

exercises.instructionEn: Use the information below to write a letter to a friend about your holiday in Rhodes.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi ma'lumotdan foydalanib, do'stingizga Rodosdagi ta'tilingiz haqida xat yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI REJA:

  1-XATBOShI:
     Qayerdasiz: Rodos, Gretsiya
     Havo qanday: issiq va quyoshli
     Qayerda turibsiz: Rodos Park Suites
        mehmonxonasi, eski shahar yonida

  2-XATBOShI (nima qilgansiz):
     • Kalithea kurortiga borgan / seshanba /
       go'zal, orom bag'ishlovchi / surat
       olgan
     • eski shahar bo'ylab yurgan / kecha /
       maftunkor / sovg'alar sotib olgan

  3-XATBOShI:
     Nima qilmagansiz:
        Arxeologiya muzeyiga bormagan;
        Gidrobiologiya institutiga bormagan
     Nima qilmoqchisiz:
        muzeyga borish / ertaga tushdan keyin /
           eksponatlarni tomosha qilish uchun
        Gidrobiologiya institutiga borish /
           juma / turli baliqlarni ko'rish
           uchun

  4-XATBOShI:
     Joy haqida fikringiz: ulug'vor — bir kun
        albatta borish kerak
     Qachon qaytasiz: 2-sentyabr — o'shanda
        ko'rishguncha


TO'LIQ NAMUNA XAT:

  ─────────────────────────────────────────
  Dear Sam,

  Hello from Rhodes, Greece! The weather is
  hot and sunny and I'm having a wonderful
  time. I'm staying at the Rodos Park Suites
  Hotel near the old town.

  I've already done a lot of things. I've been
  to Kalithea Spa. I went there on Tuesday.
  It was lovely and relaxing, and I took some
  pictures. I've also walked around the old
  town. I did that yesterday. It was
  fascinating and I bought some souvenirs.

  There are a lot of things I haven't done
  yet. I haven't visited the Archaeological
  Museum and I haven't been to the
  Hydrobiological Institute. I'm visiting the
  museum tomorrow afternoon to admire the
  exhibits, and I'm going to go to the
  Hydrobiological Institute on Friday to see
  the many different fish.

  Rhodes is a magnificent place — you must
  visit it one day! I'm returning on 2nd
  September, so I'll see you then.

                            Lots of love,
                            [ismingiz]
  ─────────────────────────────────────────


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:

  Hurmatli Sem,

  Gretsiyaning Rodos orolidan salom! Havo
  issiq va quyoshli, men ajoyib vaqt
  o'tkazyapman. Eski shahar yonidagi Rodos
  Park Suites mehmonxonasida turibman.

  Allaqachon ko'p ish qildim. Kalithea
  kurortiga borganman. U yerga seshanba kuni
  bordim. Go'zal va orom bag'ishlovchi edi,
  bir necha surat oldim. Eski shahar bo'ylab
  ham yurganman. Buni kecha qildim. Maftunkor
  edi va sovg'alar sotib oldim.

  Hali qilmagan ko'p ishlarim bor.
  Arxeologiya muzeyiga bormaganman va
  Gidrobiologiya institutiga bormaganman.
  Ertaga tushdan keyin eksponatlarni tomosha
  qilish uchun muzeyga boraman, juma kuni esa
  turli baliqlarni ko'rish uchun
  Gidrobiologiya institutiga boraman.

  Rodos — ulug'vor joy, bir kun kelib albatta
  borishing kerak! 2-sentyabrda qaytaman,
  o'shanda ko'rishguncha.

                    Katta mehr bilan, [ism]
  ─────────────────────────────────────────


⚠ HAR XATBOShIDA QAYSI ZAMON:

  1-XATBOShI:
     'The weather IS hot and sunny.'
        → Present Simple
     'I'M HAVING a wonderful time.'
        → Present Continuous
     'I'M STAYING at the ... Hotel.'
        → Present Continuous

  2-XATBOShI (ASOSIY NAQSh):
     'I've BEEN to Kalithea Spa.'
        → Present Perfect (xabar)
     'I WENT there ON TUESDAY.'
        → Past Simple (aniq vaqt)
     'It WAS lovely and relaxing.'
        → Past Simple (baho)
     'I TOOK some pictures.'
        → Past Simple

  3-XATBOShI:
     'I HAVEN'T VISITED ... YET.'
        → Present Perfect INKOR
     'I'M VISITING the museum TOMORROW
      AFTERNOON.'
        → Present Continuous (aniq vaqtli reja)
     'I'M GOING TO GO ... ON FRIDAY.'
        → be going to

  4-XATBOShI:
     'Rhodes IS a magnificent place.'
        → Present Simple (fikr)
     'I'M RETURNING on 2nd September.'
        → Present Continuous (aniq sanali reja)
     'so I'LL SEE you then.'
        → WILL (va'da)


⚠ BU XAT — TO'RTINChI NUSXA:

  Jek (Qohira, CB 105)
  Laura (Dublin, GB 67)
  Janet (Amsterdam, WB 63, 17-mashq)
  Siz (Rodos, WB 63, 18-mashq)

  Kitob bir qolipni TO'RT marta beradi —
  o'quvchi uni to'liq o'zlashtirsin deb.


KO'RSATMALARNI TO'LIQ GAPGA AYLANTIRISh:

  'been to Kalithea Spa/Tuesday/lovely/
   relaxing/took pictures'
     → 'I've BEEN to Kalithea Spa. I WENT
        there ON TUESDAY. It WAS lovely and
        relaxing, and I TOOK some pictures.'

  'walked around the old town/yesterday/
   fascinating/bought some souvenirs'
     → 'I've also WALKED around the old town.
        I DID that YESTERDAY. It WAS
        fascinating and I BOUGHT some
        souvenirs.'

  'visit the museum/tomorrow afternoon/
   to admire the exhibits'
     → 'I'M VISITING the museum TOMORROW
        AFTERNOON TO ADMIRE the exhibits.'


DIQQAT — 'TO ADMIRE' va 'TO SEE':
  Ikkalasi ham MAQSAD bildiradi:
     'to admire the exhibits'
        = eksponatlarni tomosha qilish uchun
     'to see the many different fish'
        = turli baliqlarni ko'rish uchun


DIQQAT — SANALARNI YOZISh:
  'on 2nd September' = 2-sentyabrda
  'the 2nd of September' ham to'g'ri

  O'qilishi: 'the second of September'.


DIQQAT — 'LOTS OF LOVE':
  Janetning xati ham shunday tugagan.
  'Lots of love' — 'Love' dan ham iliqroq
  (yaqin do'st, oila).


RODOS HAQIDA:
  Rodos (Rhodes) — Gretsiyaning Egey
  dengizidagi katta oroli.
  Eski shahar — YUNESKO ro'yxatidagi o'rta
  asr qal'asi.
  Rasmda tepalikdagi qal'a va oq uylar
  ko'rinadi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Rhodes     = Rodos (orol)
  Greece     = Gretsiya
  a spa      = kurort, shifobaxsh suv joyi
  relaxing   = orom bag'ishlovchi
  to take pictures = surat olmoq
  the old town = eski shahar
  archaeological = arxeologik
  an institute = institut
  to admire  = tomosha qilmoq, qoyil qolmoq
  September  = sentyabr

points.en: Dear Sam, Hello from Rhodes, Greece! The weather is hot and sunny and I'm having a wonderful time. I'm staying at the Rodos Park Suites Hotel near the old town.
points.uz: Hurmatli Sem, Gretsiyaning Rodos orolidan salom! Havo issiq va quyoshli, men ajoyib vaqt o'tkazyapman. Eski shahar yonidagi Rodos Park Suites mehmonxonasida turibman.
points.noteUz:
1-XATBOSHI — UCH savolga javob:
qayerda, havo qanday, qayerda turadi.

'IS' (Present Simple) + 'AM HAVING' va
'AM STAYING' (Present Continuous).

points.en: I've already done a lot of things. I've been to Kalithea Spa. I went there on Tuesday. It was lovely and relaxing, and I took some pictures.
points.uz: Allaqachon ko'p ish qildim. Kalithea kurortiga borganman. U yerga seshanba kuni bordim. Go'zal va orom bag'ishlovchi edi, bir necha surat oldim.
points.noteUz:
⚠ ASOSIY NAQSH:
'I've BEEN' (Present Perfect — xabar) →
'I WENT there ON TUESDAY' (Past Simple) →
'It WAS lovely' (baho, Past Simple).

points.en: I've also walked around the old town. I did that yesterday. It was fascinating and I bought some souvenirs.
points.uz: Eski shahar bo'ylab ham yurganman. Buni kecha qildim. Maftunkor edi va sovg'alar sotib oldim.
points.noteUz:
Yana o'sha naqsh.
'ALSO' — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA.
'YESTERDAY' → Past Simple.

points.en: There are a lot of things I haven't done yet. I haven't visited the Archaeological Museum and I haven't been to the Hydrobiological Institute.
points.uz: Hali qilmagan ko'p ishlarim bor. Arxeologiya muzeyiga bormaganman va Gidrobiologiya institutiga bormaganman.
points.noteUz:
3-XATBOSHI — QILMAGAN ishlar.
'HAVEN'T ... YET' — Present Perfect inkor.

DIQQAT: 'haven't BEEN to' ('gone' EMAS).

points.en: I'm visiting the museum tomorrow afternoon to admire the exhibits, and I'm going to go to the Hydrobiological Institute on Friday to see the many different fish.
points.uz: Ertaga tushdan keyin eksponatlarni tomosha qilish uchun muzeyga boraman, juma kuni esa turli baliqlarni ko'rish uchun Gidrobiologiya institutiga boraman.
points.noteUz:
REJALAR:
'TOMORROW AFTERNOON' — aniq vaqt →
Present Continuous.
'ON FRIDAY' — be going to ham to'g'ri.

'TO admire', 'TO see' — MAQSAD.

points.en: Rhodes is a magnificent place — you must visit it one day! I'm returning on 2nd September, so I'll see you then. Lots of love,
points.uz: Rodos — ulug'vor joy, bir kun kelib albatta borishing kerak! 2-sentyabrda qaytaman, o'shanda ko'rishguncha. Katta mehr bilan,
points.noteUz:
4-XATBOSHI — FIKR + qachon qaytadi.

'I'M RETURNING' — aniq sanali reja;
'I'LL SEE you then' — va'da.

Uchala oldingi xat ham shu gap bilan
tugagan!

patterns.exampleEn: We have taken a boat trip. We did that on Wednesday. It was amazing!

patterns.exampleEn: They didn't visit the Van Gogh Museum on Wednesday. They visited it on Thursday.
